notes.content: The Bachelor of Arts in Music provides a humanistic approach to the study of music as a significant part of human tradition and culture. A variety of career opportunities may be open to students with this background in a liberal arts curriculum. Emphasis areas include general music and music technology. View information for the Department of Music , including Learning Objectives for the department and its programs.

The Bachelor of Arts in Music provides a humanistic approach to the study of music as a significant part of human tradition and culture. A variety of career opportunities may be open to students with this background in a liberal arts curriculum. Emphasis areas include general music and music technology.


View information for the Department of Music, including Learning Objectives for the department and its programs.

notes.content: Transfer students entering the music major must be evaluated by the Department before registering for their first semester on campus. Depending upon audition results, one to four units of lower division applied study and/or lower division Major Repertoire may be waived. Two units from Section 2 of the Lower Division Prerequisites below must be taken in consecutive semesters, as directed by the major advisor.
